d:
Bihar Museum and Patna Museum together offer a compelling account of Bihar’s remarkable civilisational and cultural legacy. Patna Museum, popularly known as “Jadu Ghar,” preserves an extensive collection of archaeological artefacts, sculptures, paintings, manuscripts and antiquities, including the celebrated Didarganj Yakshi.
Bihar Museum presents a contemporary interpretation of the region’s history, art and cultural traditions, bringing together antiquities, manuscripts, traditional art and contemporary expressions.
